findings.title: Kafka host-alias mismatch
findings.what: Config/.env default KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP=kafka:9092 (matches docs/07 §2 verbatim), but the Redpanda container advertises PLAINTEXT://redpanda:9092 with no 'kafka' network alias on acip-net.
findings.why: Does not block Phase 1 because no service opens a producer/consumer this phase. The phase that wires the first Kafka consumer must either add a 'kafka' network alias to the redpanda service or change the default to redpanda:9092, or an in-network client will fail DNS resolution.

findings.title: Live stack not exercised (deferred, documented)
findings.what: Live docker compose up, healthcheck-green status, rpk topic creation, and live seed.py idempotency were not run because the Docker daemon was down.
findings.why: Acceptable for Phase 1: the compose config validates statically and all code paths (healthchecks, kafka-init topic creation, seed connection guards) are wired and reviewable. Must be verified in the phase that first stands up the stack.
